sort.title_vi: Xếp mỗi câu vào đúng thì (ôn buổi 2–4)

groups.name: Past continuous
items: At 9 p.m. yesterday, we were watching TV.
While Dad was cooking, I was reading.
They were waiting for the bus.
groups.rule_vi: **Quá khứ tiếp diễn: was/were + V-ing** – việc đang diễn ra tại một lúc trong quá khứ. Dấu hiệu: ==At 9 p.m. yesterday==, ==While==. __Tìm was/were đi với V-ing.__

groups.name: Present perfect
items: I have already finished my project.
groups.rule_vi: **Hiện tại hoàn thành: have/has + V3** – trải nghiệm hoặc việc vừa xong. Dấu hiệu: ==already==, ==twice==, ==yet==. __Câu không có mốc thời gian cụ thể trong quá khứ.__

groups.name: Future (will / be going to / present continuous)
items: We're going to visit Hue next summer.
I think robots will do our housework one day.
I'm meeting Lan at 5 p.m. tomorrow.
groups.rule_vi: **Tương lai**: be going to (dự định), will (dự đoán), hiện tại tiếp diễn (lịch hẹn). Dấu hiệu: ==next summer==, ==one day==, ==tomorrow==. __Thấy thời gian ở tương lai thì xếp vào nhóm này.__

unjumble.sentence: We were having dinner when the power went off.
unjumble.hint_vi: Quá khứ tiếp diễn + when + quá khứ đơn (buổi 2)
unjumble.why_vi: **S + was/were + V-ing + when + quá khứ đơn**: ==We were having dinner== when ==the power went off==. __Việc dài đứng trước, việc ngắn xen vào sau when.__

unjumble.sentence: Have you ever travelled abroad with your family?
unjumble.hint_vi: Hiện tại hoàn thành với ever (buổi 3)
unjumble.why_vi: Câu hỏi HTHT: **Have + S + ever + V3?** ==Have you ever travelled abroad==… __ever đứng sau chủ ngữ, trước V3.__

unjumble.sentence: I'm going to take up the guitar next month.
unjumble.hint_vi: be going to: dự định có từ trước (buổi 4)
unjumble.why_vi: **be going to + V**: ==I'm going to take up the guitar==, thời gian ==next month== ở cuối. __take up đi liền nhau, the guitar làm tân ngữ.__

unjumble.sentence: It was such a boring film that I fell asleep.
unjumble.hint_vi: such + a + tính từ + danh từ + that (buổi 5)
unjumble.why_vi: **such + a + adj + N + that**: ==such a boring film that== I fell asleep. __a đứng sau such, trước tính từ.__

unjumble.sentence: You don't have to bring your own lunch.
unjumble.hint_vi: don't have to = không cần phải (buổi 6)
unjumble.why_vi: **S + don't have to + V**: ==You don't have to bring your own lunch.== __your own đứng trước danh từ lunch.__

truefalse.s: She is owning two cats and a dog.
truefalse.fix: She owns two cats and a dog.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==is owning== → **owns**: own là động từ trạng thái, không chia -ing. __own, know, like, have (sở hữu) đều không dùng tiếp diễn.__

truefalse.s: I was doing my homework when my friend called.
truefalse.fix: I was doing my homework when my friend called.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. ==was doing== bị ==called== xen vào → **quá khứ tiếp diễn + when + quá khứ đơn**.

truefalse.s: We have moved to Hanoi in 2019.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. Có ==in 2019== (mốc thời gian xác định) → **quá khứ đơn: moved**. __HTHT không đi với năm, ago, yesterday.__

truefalse.s: I'm sure you will pass the test.
truefalse.fix: I'm sure you will pass the test.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. ==I'm sure== là dự đoán theo ý kiến → **will + V**. __I think, I'm sure, probably hay đi với will.__

truefalse.s: Hoa is more taller than her sister.
truefalse.fix: Hoa is taller than her sister.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==more taller== → **taller**: tính từ ngắn chỉ thêm -er. __Không dùng more và -er cùng lúc.__

truefalse.s: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.
truefalse.fix: You mustn't use your phone during the exam.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. Cấm dùng điện thoại ==during the exam== → **mustn't + V**.

truefalse.s: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
truefalse.fix: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
truefalse.why_vi: Đúng. ==the most interesting== + ==I have ever read== → **so sánh nhất của tính từ dài + HTHT với ever**.

truefalse.s: He is enough old to drive a car.
truefalse.fix: He is old enough to drive a car.
truefalse.why_vi: Sai. ==enough old== → **old enough**: enough đứng SAU tính từ. __Còn với danh từ thì enough đứng trước: enough money.__

exam.intro_vi: Đề thật trộn nhiều dạng: đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 60 câu trắc nghiệm, đề chung có ngữ âm, trọng âm, hội thoại, viết lại câu. Bài này gồm 10 câu trộn các dạng của buổi 1–6.
exam.tip_vi: Đọc nhãn [ ] để biết dạng bài trước. Câu nào chưa chắc thì làm câu khác trước rồi quay lại.

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] Phong ______ on his maths homework at the moment, so please don't disturb him.
items.explain_vi: ==at the moment== → **hiện tại tiếp diễn: is concentrating**. __at the moment, now, Look! là dấu hiệu tiếp diễn.__

items.q: [Phát âm] Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: device tận cùng âm /s/ nên **devices** đọc /ɪz/; ==souvenirs, journeys, passengers== đọc /z/. __Âm cuối /s, z, ʃ, tʃ, dʒ/ thì -s/-es đọc /ɪz/.__

items.q: [Trọng âm] Chọn từ có trọng âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: **explore** là động từ, nhấn âm 2: ex-PLORE. ==habit, diet, journey== là danh từ, nhấn âm 1. __Danh từ 2 âm tiết thường nhấn âm 1, động từ thường nhấn âm 2.__

items.q: [Đồng nghĩa] Our flight to Da Nang was DELAYED because of the heavy storm.
items.explain_vi: ==DELAYED== (bị chậm, đến muộn) đồng nghĩa với **held up**. __cancelled là bị huỷ hẳn, khác nghĩa.__

items.q: [Trái nghĩa] This street is always CROWDED on Saturday evenings.
items.explain_vi: ==CROWDED== (đông đúc) trái nghĩa với **empty** (vắng). __busy, full gần nghĩa với crowded nên là bẫy.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: I've had a headache all morning.
B: ______
options: You should lie down for a while.
items.explain_vi: A nói ==I've had a headache all morning== → đưa lời khuyên: **You should lie down for a while.** __Ai than mệt, ốm thì đáp bằng lời khuyên với should.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Sunday?
B: ______
options: I'd love to. What time does it start?
I'm going to have a party.
items.explain_vi: Lời mời ==Would you like to come...?== → nhận lời: **I'd love to.** __'Yes, I do' trả lời câu Do you…, không hợp câu Would you like.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] I started learning English five years ago.
options: I have learnt English for five years.
I learnt English five years ago.
I haven't learnt English for five years.
I have learnt English since five years.
items.explain_vi: ==started ... five years ago== → **I have learnt English for five years.** __for + khoảng thời gian; 'since five years' sai.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] The bag was so heavy that Lan couldn't carry it.
options: The bag was too heavy for Lan to carry.
The bag was heavy enough for Lan to carry.
Lan was strong enough to carry the bag.
It was such heavy bag that Lan couldn't carry it.
items.explain_vi: ==so heavy that Lan couldn't carry it== → **too heavy for Lan to carry**. __D thiếu 'a': phải là such a heavy bag.__

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] My dad used to smoke, but he ______ it up three years ago.
items.explain_vi: ==three years ago== → quá khứ đơn; **give up** là từ bỏ thói quen → **gave**. __took up là bắt đầu, ngược nghĩa.__

exam_easy.intro_vi: Đề thi thật trộn nhiều dạng bài trong cùng một đề. Bài này có 10 câu ngắn trộn các dạng của buổi 1–6: hoàn thành câu, phát âm, trọng âm, đồng nghĩa, trái nghĩa, hội thoại, câu gần nghĩa.
exam_easy.tip_vi: Mẹo: đọc nhãn [ ] để biết dạng bài. Tìm từ gợi ý thời gian (now, ago, for) trước khi chọn. Câu khó thì làm sau.

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] Listen! My sister ______ the piano in her room.
items.explain_vi: ==Listen!== → việc đang xảy ra lúc nói: **is playing**. __Listen!, Look! là dấu hiệu hiện tại tiếp diễn.__

items.q: [Phát âm] Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: book tận cùng âm /k/ (vô thanh) nên **books** đọc /s/; ==pens, bags, chairs== đọc /z/. __Âm cuối vô thanh /p, t, k, f/ thì -s đọc /s/.__

items.q: [Trọng âm] Chọn từ có trọng âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: **hotel** nhấn âm 2: ho-TEL. ==teacher, happy, table== đều nhấn âm 1. __Đọc to từng từ để nghe chỗ nhấn mạnh.__

items.q: [Đồng nghĩa] After school, I usually RELAX by listening to music.
items.explain_vi: ==RELAX== (thư giãn) gần nghĩa với **rest** (nghỉ ngơi). __study, run, shout khác nghĩa hẳn.__

items.q: [Trái nghĩa] Plastic bags are HARMFUL to sea animals.
items.explain_vi: ==HARMFUL== (có hại) trái nghĩa với **harmless** (vô hại). __-ful là có, -less là không có; dangerous, bad là bẫy cùng nghĩa.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: Excuse me, can I take photos in the museum?
B: ______
options: Sorry, you can't. Look at the sign.
items.explain_vi: A xin phép ==can I take photos in the museum?== → B trả lời không được: **Sorry, you can't. Look at the sign.** __Các câu khác không trả lời câu xin phép.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: What are you going to do this weekend?
B: ______
options: I'm going to visit my grandparents.
I visit my grandparents every day.
items.explain_vi: Hỏi dự định ==What are you going to do this weekend?== → **I'm going to visit my grandparents.** __Hỏi bằng thì nào, trả lời bằng thì đó.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] My brother is older than me.
options: I am older than my brother.
My brother is younger than me.
I am younger than my brother.
My brother and I are the same age.
items.explain_vi: ==My brother is older than me== → bạn nhỏ tuổi hơn anh: **I am younger than my brother.** __Đổi chủ ngữ thì đổi older thành younger.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] I have lived in Hà Nội for three years.
options: I lived in Hà Nội three years ago.
I moved to Hà Nội three years ago.
I will live in Hà Nội for three years.
I have never lived in Hà Nội.
items.explain_vi: ==have lived ... for three years== (giờ vẫn sống ở đó) → **I moved to Hà Nội three years ago.** __A sai vì 'lived … ago' nghĩa là giờ không còn sống ở đó.__

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] Please ______ off the lights when you leave the room.
items.explain_vi: **switch off** là tắt (đèn, máy); ==off the lights== là dấu hiệu. __give off, take off, drop off không có nghĩa tắt đèn.__

exam_plus.intro_vi: Đề Chuyên Ngoại ngữ có 60 câu trắc nghiệm trộn nhiều dạng; các câu phân loại thường gài bẫy ở động từ trạng thái, Do you mind…?, từ gần nghĩa. Bài này có 10 câu như vậy, ôn buổi 1–6.
exam_plus.tip_vi: Mẹo: với câu khó, loại trước phương án sai ngữ pháp, rồi so sắc thái nghĩa của hai phương án còn lại. Đừng chọn chỉ vì thấy từ quen.

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] This soup ______ delicious. Can I have some more?
items.explain_vi: taste (có vị) là **động từ trạng thái** → **tastes**; dấu hiệu ==delicious==. __'is tasting' chỉ dùng khi ai đó đang nếm thử.__

items.q: [Phát âm] Chọn từ có phần gạch chân phát âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: breathe tận cùng âm /ð/ (hữu thanh) nên **breathes** đọc /z/; ==months, breaths, laughs== tận cùng âm vô thanh nên đọc /s/. __Nghe âm cuối, đừng nhìn chữ: breath /θ/ khác breathe /ð/.__

items.q: [Trọng âm] Chọn từ có trọng âm khác các từ còn lại.
items.explain_vi: **concentrate** nhấn âm 1: CON-cen-trate. ==recycle, assignment, pollution== nhấn âm 2. __Đuôi -tion luôn nhấn âm ngay trước nó: pol-LU-tion.__

items.q: [Đồng nghĩa] After failing three times, Tuấn almost GAVE UP learning the guitar, but his teacher encouraged him to keep trying.
items.explain_vi: ==GAVE UP== (từ bỏ) đồng nghĩa với **quit**. __put off là hoãn, cut down on là giảm bớt, took up là bắt đầu.__

items.q: [Trái nghĩa] The museum guide was so ENTHUSIASTIC that even the youngest visitors listened carefully.
items.explain_vi: ==ENTHUSIASTIC== (nhiệt tình) trái nghĩa với **indifferent** (thờ ơ). __eager, energetic gần nghĩa nên là bẫy.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: I'm sorry I couldn't make it to your party last night.
B: ______
options: Not at all. I'd love to.
items.explain_vi: Đáp lại lời xin lỗi ==I'm sorry I couldn't make it== → **Never mind. Maybe next time.** __'Not at all. I'd love to' dùng để nhận lời mời.__

items.q:
[Hội thoại] A: Do you mind if I switch off the air conditioner?
B: ______
items.explain_vi: ==Do you mind if...?== nghĩa là 'bạn có phiền không' → đồng ý thì nói **Not at all. Go ahead.** __'Yes' ở đây nghĩa là có phiền, nên 'Yes, please do' mâu thuẫn.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] It's ages since I last went cycling.
options: I have been cycling for ages.
It took me ages to go cycling.
I haven't been cycling for ages.
items.explain_vi: ==It's ages since I last went cycling== → **I haven't been cycling for ages.** __It's + thời gian + since + S + last + V2 ↔ S + haven't + V3 + for + thời gian.__

items.q: [Câu gần nghĩa] Hoa didn't use to enjoy cooking, but now she loves it.
options: Hoa enjoys cooking more now than she used to.
Hoa enjoyed cooking more in the past than she does now.
items.explain_vi: ==didn't use to enjoy cooking, but now she loves it== → **Hoa enjoys cooking more now than she used to.** __C ngược nghĩa vì nói trước đây thích hơn.__

items.q: [Hoàn thành câu] Minh ______ a lot of progress in English since he started reading graded readers.
items.explain_vi: ==since he started== → HTHT; cụm **make progress** → **has made**. __Không nói 'do progress'.__

paper_plus.instruction_vi: Ôn buổi 1–6. Câu 1–2: viết dạng đúng của từ in hoa (từ phải đổi hai lần). Câu 3–4: viết tiếp câu mới sao cho nghĩa không đổi. Câu 5–6: chọn A, B, C hoặc D.

items.q: Many parents worry that their children waste hours on ______ activities such as scrolling through social media. (PRODUCT)
items.explain_vi: Trước danh từ ==activities== cần tính từ; lướt mạng xã hội là vô ích: product → productive → **unproductive**. __Từ đổi hai lần: thêm -ive rồi thêm un-.__

items.q: Our school canteen has switched to paper straws and other ______ friendly products. (ENVIRONMENT)
items.explain_vi: Đứng trước tính từ ==friendly== cần **trạng từ**: environment → **environmentally**. __Cụm cố định: environmentally friendly (thân thiện với môi trường).__

items.q: I last saw my cousin when she moved to Australia two years ago. → I haven't ______
items.answer: seen my cousin since she moved to Australia two years ago
accept: seen my cousin since she moved to Australia
seen her since she moved to Australia two years ago
seen her since she moved to Australia
seen my cousin for two years
items.explain_vi: ==I last saw my cousin when...== → **I haven't seen my cousin since she moved to Australia two years ago.** __last + V2 ↔ haven't + V3 + since/for.__

items.q: My town is much noisier now than it was in the past. → My town didn't ______
accept: use to be as noisy as it is now
use to be so noisy as it is now
items.explain_vi: ==much noisier now than it was in the past== → trước đây không ồn như vậy: **didn't use to be so noisy**. __Sau didn't dùng 'use to', không có -d.__

items.q: If you keep ______ your revision until the night before the test, you won't remember everything.
items.explain_vi: **put off** (C) là trì hoãn; ==until the night before the test== là dấu hiệu. __keep + V-ing; setting off là khởi hành, taking off là cất cánh.__

items.q: Studying abroad for a year really ______ my horizons; I learnt to see things from many different points of view.
items.explain_vi: Cụm cố định **broaden my horizons** (B): mở rộng tầm nhìn; dấu hiệu ==see things from many different points of view==. __enlarge, increase không đi với horizons.__

hints.d7R3_4: trạng từ (bổ nghĩa cho động từ listened)
hints.d7R3_5: tính từ, nghĩa phủ định (không thể)

writing_starters: Hi Alex, How are you? I want to tell you about my new …
I used to …, but now I …
What about you? Write back soon.

part1.intro_vi: Bạn nghe Linh và Nam nói về kế hoạch cuối tuần: bài tập, sở thích mới và ngày tái chế. Chọn đáp án đúng.

script.t: Hi Nam. What are you doing this weekend?
I have to finish my history assignment. It's about our town, and I haven't started it yet.
Oh no! When do you have to hand it in?
On Monday. So I'm going to stay at home all day on Saturday. What about you?
I've just taken up drawing. My first class is on Saturday morning.
That's cool. You're really creative, Linh.
Thanks! And on Sunday, I'm helping at the recycling day at school. We're collecting old paper and plastic bottles.
Can I come too? I've got lots of old newspapers at home. My dad never throws them away.
Of course! Come at nine o'clock, and bring the newspapers in a big bag.
Great. See you on Sunday, then!

items.q: What is Nam's history assignment about?
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==It's about our town.== → **Their town**.

items.q: When does Nam have to hand in his assignment?
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==On Monday.== → **On Monday**. __Thứ Bảy là ngày cậu ở nhà làm bài, không phải ngày nộp.__

items.q: What has Linh just started?
items.explain_vi: Linh: ==I've just taken up drawing. My first class is on Saturday morning.== → **Drawing classes**. __take up nghĩa là bắt đầu một sở thích.__

items.q: What will Linh do on Sunday?
items.explain_vi: Linh: ==on Sunday, I'm helping at the recycling day at school.== → **Help at a recycling day**.

items.q: What will Nam bring on Sunday?
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==I've got lots of old newspapers at home.== → **Old newspapers**. __Chai nhựa là thứ cả trường thu gom, không phải thứ Nam mang.__

part2.intro_vi: Bạn nghe cô Green thông báo về các câu lạc bộ mùa hè của trường. Điền một từ hoặc một con số vào mỗi chỗ trống.
part2.script: Good morning, everyone. This is Mrs Green with some news about our summer clubs. This summer, the school is starting three new clubs. The photography club meets on Tuesday afternoons in the library. Please bring your own camera or phone. The cooking club is on Thursdays, in the school kitchen. You'll learn to make nutritious food for your family. The third club is the robot club. It meets on Saturday mornings in the computer room. Only 20 students can join, so sign up early! To join a club, write your name on the list outside the teachers' room before Friday. Have a lovely summer!
part2.text:
SUMMER CLUBS
• Photography club: Tuesday afternoons in the [1]
• Bring your own [2] or phone
• Cooking club: in the school [3]
• Robot club: only [4] students
• Sign up: write your name on the list before [5]

items.explain_vi: Cô nói: ==The photography club meets on Tuesday afternoons in the library.== → **library**.
==Please bring your own camera or phone.== → **camera**. __Chữ 'or phone' sau chỗ trống giúp bạn nhận ra câu cần nghe.__
==The cooking club is on Thursdays, in the school kitchen.== → **kitchen**.
==Only 20 students can join, so sign up early!== → **20**.
==write your name on the list outside the teachers' room before Friday== → **Friday**. __Nghe kỹ chữ 'before' trước mốc thời gian.__

part1.intro_vi: Bạn nghe Mai và Tom nói về việc ôn thi và điện thoại. Chú ý chỗ người nói đổi ý hoặc sửa lại. Chọn đáp án đúng.

script.t: Tom, you look exhausted. Were you up late again?
Yeah. I was revising for the science test until midnight. Well, not exactly revising. I kept checking my phone.
That's the problem, isn't it? It's impossible to concentrate when your phone is right next to you.
I know. How do you manage? You always get such good marks.
I switch my phone off and leave it in the living room. My mum keeps it until I've finished.
Your mum? I'd never ask my mum to do that!
It works, though. I used to study for three hours and remember nothing. Now I study for an hour and a half, but I actually learn more.
Hmm. Maybe I should try it. I missed two lessons last week because of my cold, so I really need to catch up.
Do you want to revise together? We could go to the library on Thursday after school.
Thursday's no good. I've got football practice. What about Wednesday?
Wednesday's fine. Bring your notes from Mr Brown's lessons, and I'll bring mine.
Thanks, Mai. You're a lifesaver.

items.q: Why did Tom go to bed late?
options: He had a late football match.
He was studying but kept looking at his phone.
items.explain_vi: Tom: ==Well, not exactly revising. I kept checking my phone.== → **He was studying but kept looking at his phone.** __'not exactly' báo hiệu người nói sửa lại ý.__

items.q: What does Mai do with her phone when she studies?
options: She puts it in her bag.
She uses it only to check answers.
She keeps it on her desk.
She leaves it with her mum.
items.explain_vi: Mai: ==I switch my phone off and leave it in the living room. My mum keeps it until I've finished.== → **She leaves it with her mum.**

items.q: What does Mai say about the way she studies now?
options: She studies longer than she used to.
She studies for a shorter time but learns more.
She studies for three hours every evening.
She only studies with her friends.
items.explain_vi: ==Now I study for an hour and a half, but I actually learn more.== → **She studies for a shorter time but learns more.** __So sánh 3 tiếng trước đây với 1 tiếng rưỡi bây giờ.__

items.q: Why does Tom need to catch up?
options: He was ill and missed some lessons.
He failed his last science test.
He spent too much time on football.
items.explain_vi: Tom: ==I missed two lessons last week because of my cold.== → **He was ill and missed some lessons.** __'cold' ở đây là bị cảm.__

items.q: When will Mai and Tom revise together?
items.explain_vi: Tom bận thứ Năm nên hỏi ==What about Wednesday?== – Mai: ==Wednesday's fine.== → **On Wednesday**. __Đáp án là ngày cả hai cùng đồng ý.__

part2.intro_vi: Bạn nghe giới thiệu chương trình hè Summer Challenge. Có một chỗ người nói sửa lại thông tin. Điền 1–2 từ hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Hi, everyone. I'm Anna from the City Youth Centre, and I'm here to tell you about our Summer Challenge programme. It's for students aged twelve to fifteen, and it runs for four weeks in July. Every week has a different theme. In week one, you'll explore the city's old streets and learn about their history. In week two, we'll go to the countryside to plant trees and learn how to protect the environment. Week three is our creative week. You'll work in teams to make a short film, using only your phones. And in the final week, we'll have a sports day. Oh, sorry, I need to correct that. The sports day was last year. This year, the final week is a cooking competition. Places are limited to 40 students, so please register soon. You can do it at our office or on our website.
part2.text:
SUMMER CHALLENGE (July)
• Week 1: explore the city's old [1]
• Week 2: plant [2] in the countryside
• Week 3: make a short [3] with your phone
• Week 4: a [4] competition
• Number of places: [5]

items.explain_vi: ==In week one, you'll explore the city's old streets== → **streets**.
==we'll go to the countryside to plant trees== → **trees**.
==You'll work in teams to make a short film, using only your phones.== → **film**.
Ngày hội thể thao là năm ngoái; Anna sửa: ==This year, the final week is a cooking competition.== → **cooking**. __Nghe 'sorry, I need to correct that' thì chờ thông tin mới.__
==Places are limited to 40 students== → **40**.

part1.intro_vi: Bạn nghe Anna và Nam nói về việc Nam định rời câu lạc bộ tranh biện. Câu hỏi về ý kiến, thái độ và suy luận.

script.t: Nam, is it true you're dropping out of the debate club? Linh told me this morning.
Well, I'm thinking about it, but I haven't made up my mind yet. With the entrance exam coming, I just don't have enough spare time.
But you're the most enthusiastic member we've got! You've hardly missed a single meeting since you joined.
That's true, and I really enjoy it. But my parents think I should spend every free minute revising.

I understand. My parents used to say the same thing. But honestly, the debate club has improved my English more than any textbook. And it teaches you to think quickly and organise your ideas. That's useful in every subject, not just English.
I hadn't thought about it that way. Still, two hours every Friday is a lot.
What if you came every other week? Mr Brown wouldn't mind, I'm sure. He's let other students do that before.
Maybe. Although if I only came half the time, I'd feel I was letting the team down.
Look, it's your decision. But giving it up completely seems like such a waste. You've worked so hard for this team.
I know. Okay, how about this? I'll talk to Mr Brown first and see what he suggests. Then I'll decide.
That sounds sensible. And remember, the city competition is in May. It'd be a shame to miss it.
Exactly. To be honest, that's the main reason I don't want to leave.

items.q: At the start of the conversation, what is true about Nam?
options: He has already left the debate club.
He hasn't decided whether to leave the club.
His parents have told him to leave immediately.
Linh has asked him to leave.
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==I'm thinking about it, but I haven't made up my mind yet.== → **He hasn't decided whether to leave the club.** __make up one's mind nghĩa là quyết định.__

items.q: Why is Nam thinking of leaving the club?
options: He doesn't get on with Mr Brown.
He needs more time to prepare for an exam.
His English is not good enough.
items.explain_vi: ==With the entrance exam coming, I just don't have enough spare time.== → **He needs more time to prepare for an exam.** __A sai vì Nam nói cậu rất thích câu lạc bộ.__

items.q: What does Anna believe about the debate club?
options: It develops skills that are useful in all subjects.
It is less useful than studying from textbooks.
It is only suitable for students with very good English.
It takes up too much of its members' time.
items.explain_vi: Anna: ==it teaches you to think quickly and organise your ideas. That's useful in every subject== → **It develops skills that are useful in all subjects.**

items.q: Why is Nam unsure about coming every other week?
options: Mr Brown has never allowed it before.
He would rather leave the club completely.
He has other lessons on Fridays.
He worries he would disappoint his team.
items.explain_vi: ==I'd feel I was letting the team down== → **He worries he would disappoint his team.** __let sb down nghĩa là làm ai thất vọng.__

items.q: What is Nam's plan at the end of the conversation?
options: To leave the club at once
To come to the club every other week
To ask the teacher's advice before deciding
To ask his parents to talk to Mr Brown
items.explain_vi: Nam: ==I'll talk to Mr Brown first and see what he suggests. Then I'll decide.== → **To ask the teacher's advice before deciding.** __Đi cách tuần chỉ là gợi ý của Anna.__

part2.intro_vi: Bạn nghe hướng dẫn viên ở Vườn quốc gia Cúc Phương dặn dò trước chuyến đi bộ. Có nhiều thông tin gây nhiễu. Điền 1–2 từ hoặc một con số.
part2.script: Good morning, and welcome to Cuc Phuong National Park, the oldest national park in Vietnam. I'm Mai, and I'll be your guide on today's walk. Before we start, a few rules. First, you mustn't leave any rubbish in the forest. Even small things like sweet wrappers can be harmful to animals, so please carry your waste with you until we reach the bins at the visitor centre. Second, the forest is home to hundreds of species of birds, so please keep your voices down. Now, some of you have asked whether we'll see the park's rare monkeys. Unfortunately, they're extremely shy, so you probably won't see them in the wild. However, you can see them up close at the rescue centre. Your printed programme says we'll go there before lunch, but in fact we'll visit it after lunch. As for phones, there's no signal in most of the forest, so you can't rely on online maps. Stay close to the group and follow the red signs, not the yellow ones, which are for the longer trail. Our walk takes about 3 hours, and the path is quite steep in places, so make sure you're wearing proper shoes.
part2.text:
CUC PHUONG FOREST WALK
• Carry your rubbish to the bins at the [1]
• Rare monkeys: see them at the [2]
• We visit them: [3] lunch
• Follow the [4] signs
• Length of walk: about [5] hours

items.explain_vi: ==carry your waste with you until we reach the bins at the visitor centre== → **visitor centre**.
==you can see them up close at the rescue centre== → **rescue centre**. __Ngoài rừng khó thấy khỉ vì chúng rất nhút nhát.__
Tờ chương trình ghi trước bữa trưa, nhưng ==in fact we'll visit it after lunch== → **after**. __'in fact' báo hiệu thông tin đúng.__
==follow the red signs, not the yellow ones== → **red**. __Biển vàng dành cho đường dài hơn, là bẫy.__
Mai nói: ==Our walk takes about 3 hours== → **3**.
